item.title: b. expressions
item.description: Expressions and Sentences merely for pleasure: adv. only. 仅仅 We play games merely for pleasure. (我们玩游戏仅仅是为了快乐) Captain Alison sails his small boat across the Atlantic merely to seek adventure. （Alison 船长驾驶他的小船穿越大西洋仅仅是为了去寻求冒险） N212 。 to seek 强化目的。 Percy Buttons begs for food merely for being alive to survive. （Percy 乞讨食物仅仅是为了生存） N2L6 being alive 替换成 to survive 或 to stay alive 更地道。 observant : adj.

item.title: b. expressions
have a seat
item.description: Take a seat. (请坐) Have a seat. (更随意) Please be seated. (更正式，如会议、典礼) Is this seat taken. （这个座位有人吗？）座位被占了了吗？ All seats are taken. I’m afraid we’re fully booked. (用于餐厅、酒店预订) The flight is full. (用于航班) It’s a full house. (用于剧院、体育馆，强调“座无虚席”的热闹场面) I’ll leave save a seat for you. (我给你留个位）。 I’ll save a seat for you. (用 save 比 leave 更主动，更显体贴，尤其在教室、会议中更常用) I’ve got a seat for you. (已经占好了，直接告知) It’s a hot performance, there’s no seat left.
